title: The Morning Digest: November 12, 2026
dek: Brent Jan27 settled at $92.76 on Wednesday, up $1.27 or 1.4 percent, and WTI Dec26 settled at $86.53, up $0.49 or 0.6 percent (Bloomberg via Rigzone, Nov 11), after intraday highs near $94.26 and $88.31 faded into the close, and by 0426 GMT Thursday Brent was $91.29 and WTI $85.29 (Reuters, Nov 12). January WCS is -$24.85 (ICE TMW settle, Nov 11), wider by $0.45 on 500 lots, a second straight traded widening, and January Houston widened $0.50 on 500 lots in parallel, while December marked unchanged on zero lots for a fifth straight session without a trade. The OPEC monthly report (Nov 11) leaves demand growth unchanged and has OPEC+ production up 2.04 million barrels a day in October. The delayed inventory report for the week ending Nov 6 lands today at 12:00 p.m. ET against an API print of a 9.0 million barrel crude build. The validated diesel crack is $91.43.
